Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh after picking two early wickets could not capitalize on their start. Their spinners leaked runs in the middle overs. Mehedi Hasan bowled quite economically and was the pick of the bowlers. Bangladesh who scored 340 runs in their last game against Pakistan, would want to repeat their batting performance here. Can Bangladesh chase this score down and spring a surprise or will the formidable Indian bowling attack come out and do its job? Join us for the chase in a while.

After losing two early wickets,India have managed to score 324 runs. They will be really happy with their batting performance. Dinesh Karthik and Shikhar Dhawan both scored fifties. They shared a partnership of 100 which help steady the ship after India lost two early wickets.
SIX! Finishes the innings with a maximum. Full ball and Pandya hits it way over the long on fence for a huge maximum. A very good innings by Pandya.
Back of a length ball, Pandya cuts it through point for a couple.
The batsman just manages to keep the yorker out. Good ball bowled by the bowler. One run added to the total.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar comes out to bat.
OUT! BOWLED'EM! Goes for the paddle sweep, Rubel bowls it full. Ashwin misses and gets his stumps knocked over.
FOUR! Full ball and Ashwin lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Goes for the paddle sweep, Rubel Hossain bowls it full. Pandya gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls on the off side and they run through for a single.
The batsman gives this a full swing of the bat, and connects. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! Big hit from Pandya. Shuffles across the stumps, the bowler bowls a full toss. Pandya slogs it over mid-wicket for a huge maximum.
The batsman charges down the wicket. One run added to the total.
Lands on off, Pandya drives it to long off for a run.
FOUR! Slapped! Full outside off. Pandya slaps it through covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Bowls it outside off, the umpire signals wide.
Drives it through mid on and they run two.
Sunzamul Islam comes on to bowl.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.
Ravichandran Ashwin comes into bat. It's getting overcast here.
OUT! There goes Jadeja. Length ball outside off, Jadeja goes for a heave on the leg side but gets a top edge and it is gobbled at covers.
Full on the pads, Pandya flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Very full, wide outside off. Jadeja plays it to point for a run.
Full ball, Pandya drives it down to long on for a run.
Full outside off, Jadeja smashes it down the ground for a run.
Rubel Hossain comes on to bowl.
Right in the blockhole, Pandya digs it out on the off side for a run.
Slower ball on off, Jadeja plays it to the off side for a run.
Full toss on the pads, Jadeja flicks it to deep square leg for a couple.
WIDE! Way too short, bounces way above the batsman's head and is called wide.
Back of a length ball, Pandya pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! SMASHED! Full toss outside off, Pandya smashes it through covers for a boundary. He has played a handy knock here.
YORKER! Right on the stumps, Jadeja moves away and digs it out to covers for a run.
Cuts the short ball to point for a run.
Fired outside off, Jadeja goes to cut but fails to get bat on it.
SIX! THATS BIG! Tosses it up on middle. Jadeja walks down the track and lofts it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Drives the middle stump ball down to long on for a run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
50 for Pandya. It has been a very good knock by Hardik Pandya. He has played a very sensible innings.
Tosses it up and Pandya lofts it over covers for a couple. Brings up his fifty with that couple.
Full toss ball, Jadeja tries to drive it through covers but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls on the leg side. They run two.
Length ball on off, Pandya plays it with soft hands on the off side for a run.
Full outside off, Pandya drives it square on the off side, for a couple.
SIX! HUGE! Length ball on middle, Pandya heaves it over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum. Ten runs of two balls.
FOUR! Comes down to the length ball outside off and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Length ball, angling away. Pandya gets beaten on the drive.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Flicks the middle stump ball to mid-wicket.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. They pick up a single.
DROPPED! Tough chance for Mushfiqur. Flatter ball outside off, Pandya goes for a drive gets an outside edge and brushes the glove of Mushfiqur and goes down to third man for a run.
Short ball, Jadeja cuts it straight to point, but a fumble there concedes a single.
Quicker ball on leg stump, Pandya drives it down the ground for a run.
Slower ball on the pads, Pandya flicks it to fine leg for a run.
BOUNCER! Well directed bouncer, Jadeja pulls it down to fine leg for a run.
Full ball outside off, Pandya drives it down to long off for a run.
Full angling into the pads, Jadeja flicks it through mid-wicket towards the long boundary and they run three.
Slower ball, down the leg side. Pandya flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Full ball on leg stump, Jadeja drives it down the ground for a run.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the bowling attack.
Short on off, Jadeja cuts it through the off side for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Jadeja drives it uppishly, but lands just short off the bowler.
Quicker ball, Pandya drives it down to long on for a run.
Flicks the leg stump ball on the leg side.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Tosses it up, Jadeja drives it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Full toss on the pads, Pandya flicks and the ball races away to the square leg fence.
Full ball, Pandya drives it straight to covers.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
SIX! EFFORTLESS! Full toss ball on leg stump, Pandya lofts it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Length ball outside off, Jadeja guides it down to third man for a run.
Back of a length, Pandya punches it off the back foot.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, Jadeja pushes it to the off side and sets off for a single. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but no referral.
A darted delivery on middle and leg, Jadeja looks to work it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads.
On middle and leg, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Jadeja gets a change of bats. MEHEDI HASAN is back on.
FOUR! A short ball outside off, Pandya pulls it through mid-wicket and gets a boundary.
WIDE. A short ball outside off, Pandya thinks about the pull but then bails out. The ball swerves a long way away and it is signalled a wide.
A slower ball, bowled full on the middle stump. Pandya goes to flick it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Length ball on the pads of the batsman, Jadeja flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Short ball, Pandya cuts it through the off side for a run.
Length ball on middle, Pandya clips it to short mid-wicket.
Length ball on off is defended from the crease.
Taskin Ahmed is brought back into the attack.
Length ball on off, Pandya punches it through the off side for a run.
Strays on the pads, Pandya flicks it uppishly through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball, Pandya drives it to covers.
Full on off, Pandya drives it down to mid off.
Full on off, the ball takes the edge of the bat and goes down to third man for a run.
Full ball outside off, Jadeja drives it behind point where Mosaddek Hossain makes a good diving stop to his right.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
Floats it up, Jadeja drives it down to long on for a run.
Flatter on off, Pandya goes back and cuts it to point for a run.
Short and the batsman punches it on the off side for a run.
Works the ball on middle to the leg side.
Comes down the track and drives the tossed up delivery to long off for a run.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pushes the length ball down the ground and the batsman run two.
Lands it on a length, Jadeja pushes it to point.
Back of a length ball, Jadeja guides it to the point region.
Short ball, batsman plays the pull shot on the leg side.

Ravindra Jadeja comes into bat. Dinesh Karthik is walking back to the dressing room, he has been called back. He has been retired out. He feels he has got good batting practice and has played a good knock there.
Driven towards the mid-on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Comes down the track and defends it off the front foot.
Bowled on the pads, Pandya tucks it on the leg side for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.

Appeal for LBW, but the batsman was struck way outside off. Full ball, Karthik walks outside off, goes for a sweep shot but is struck low on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire gives it not out.
Back of a length ball, Karthik tries to push it through the off side but gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
Lands it on a length, Karthik defends it off the front foot.
Short ball on off, Pandya upper cuts it down to third man for a run.
FOUR! GREAT SHOT! Goes for a yorker but just misses it. Ends up being a full toss, Pandya drives it beautifully down the ground for a boundary. Pandya gets off the mark.
Short ball outside off, Karthik cuts it to third man for a run.
Banged in short and pulled towards the long on boundary, does not quite get hold of it and they run two.
Tosses it on off stump, Pandya drives it to covers.
HARDIK PANDYA has walked out to bat. No Yuvraj still.
DRINKS BREAK. India going along pretty nicely. Rohit Sharma has been the only one to miss out with the others getting useful batting practice. Who will come now? Will Yuvraj stride out to bat?

OUT! BOWLED! That is the end of that. Jadhav was playing well until this point and probably got carried away. Came down the track and looked to go inside out but missed it. The leg stump is knocked out of the ground.
Full and outside off, Kedar comes down the track and blocks.
Full and around off, Dinesh goes inside out and drives it through the covers. The fielder dives to his right but cannot stop it cleanly. Three runs taken.
SIX! SMOKED! He is into the zone now. Tossed up outside off, Karthik gets down and mows it over mid-wicket for a flat hit!
FOUR! Banged in short outside off, Karthik goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
SUNZAMUL ISLAM is back on.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Nice shot. A length ball outside off, Karthik drives this down the ground and beats mid off.
Works this through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, played straight to point.
RUBEL HOSSAIN is back on now as Bangladesh decide to go back to pace.
Short and outside off, Kedar goes back and cuts it through point. The ball slows down near the ropes and the batsmen return for the third.
Comes down the track and pushes it towards long on for a run.
Meanwhile, Yuvraj Singh ambles towards the dressing room. He was sitting in the dugout but does not look fully fit.
FOUR! Tremendous power. Short and around off, Karthik goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Works this down the leg side for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Jadhav looks to drive but gets a bottom edge to the off side. Would have been a wide had he left it alone.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers but the fielder dives to his right to stop it.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, Dinesh looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge which goes wide of point. A run taken.

FOUR! The length is shorter this time and Karthik pounces on it. Goes back and punches it through the covers for a boundary! The stand is worth 43 from 41 balls. Karthik moves to 63 from 59 balls with his 5th boundary.
Full and outside off, Karthik looks to drive but gets an outside edge through the vacant slip cordon towards third man. Two runs taken.
Full and down the leg side, swept away for a couple.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Short and outside off, Kedar goes back and punches it off the back foot for a couple.
Comes down the track, but is beaten in flight. Is forced to adjust and does so awkwardly. Ends up getting a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
On middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
FOUR! SMASH! Full and down the leg side, Jadhav gets down and sweeps it powerfully over square leg for a boundary! Moves to 22 from 23 balls. The stand is worth 33 from 33 balls.
Short and wide outside off, cut away for one.
Brings his strong wrists into play and works it wide of long on for a run.
Short and outside off, punched down to long on for a single.
Landed outside off, Jadhav goes back and defends again.
On middle and leg, played straight to short mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, punched towards the bowler.
Full on middle and leg, flicked towards short fine leg.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked out.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Jadhav lets it go.
FOUR! Banged in short outside off, Jadhav goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
SHAKIB AL HASAN to bowl now.
The batsman paddles the ball down the leg side. They manage to come back for the second.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Short and outside off, cut behind point for one.
Full and down the leg side, Karthik sweeps it fine for a run.
Down the leg side, nudged fine for a single.
The batsman dances down the track and hits it to long on for a single.
Landed outside off, Jadhav misses out on the cut.
Full and outside off, now he quietly comes forward and blocks.
SIX! How has that gone all the way? A short ball on middle, Jadhav goes back and heaves it. It is not from the middle of the bat but it clears the ropes at deep mid-wicket.
Goes back and works it through square leg for a single.
Comes down the track and works it wide of long on for a couple.
Full and outside off, played towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short and outside off, Kedar goes back and looks to cut but misses. Extra bounce.
On middle and leg, flicked towards square leg.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Full and around off, pushed towards the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comes down the track and drives it to long off for a single.
KEDAR JADHAV walks in now, at number 5, replacing Dhawan.

OUT! Taken! But not a bad outing for Dhawan. He has got a good batting practice. Flighted on middle, Dhawan comes down the track and looks to go over the top but cannot clear Mehedi Hasan at short mid-wicket. Simple catch.
Gets down and plays it fine through fine leg for a couple. 100-run stand is up!
FOUR! Backs away to the leg side, Dhawan goes back and punches it behind point for a boundary again!
FOUR! Nice shot. Full on middle, Dhawan comes down the track and flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
FOUR! Short and outside off, Karthik cuts it uppishly behind point for a boundary!
A short ball down the leg side, DK looks to pull but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Goes back and works it straight to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! STUPENDOUS! Just a fraction too short, around middle, Karthik goes back and heaves it over widish mid on for a boundary! Moves to 41 from 42 balls with his third boundary.
HALF CENTURY FOR DHAWAN. He has had a good outing. Goes deep in his crease and punches it through the covers for a single.
MOSADDEK HOSSAIN to bowl his offies now.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through square leg for one more.

FOUR! Nicely done. Dhawan is picking up the tempo now. Good use of his feet, gets to the pitch of the flighted ball and works it over mid-wicket for a boundary to bring up the 100 FOR INDIA. The stand is worth 80 from 88 balls.
Full and outside off, spinning away slightly, gently tapped behind point for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
CLOSE! Darts this down the leg side. Shikhar attempts to play the paddle but misses. The ball goes past his pads and just misses the leg stump!
Landed outside off, Dhawan backs away to go inside out but the ball spins in and cramps him for room. He ends up pushing it away.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Works it through the leg side for a run.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. One run added to the total.

Something happened there. Not sure what. Mehedi was almost about to deliver but then someone moved in the field. Perhaps someone at extra cover or sweeper and Mehedi pulled out of his stride very late, completing a clockwise motion. Even umpire Marais Erasmus had a smile.
Full and outside off, driven wide of mid off for a single.
FOUR! Finally he connects. He has been itching to go after the spinners for quite a while and eventually gets a loose delivery. A full toss, he just lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Karthik leans and works it through fine leg for a single.
Jumps down the track and pushes it to long on for a single. End of a tidy over. Just 4 from it.
A tad short, SD sits down on a knee and heaves it past square leg for one.
Short and outside off, punched behind point for a run.
This time Shikhar stays in his crease and pushes it with soft hands behind point for a single.
Again, he comes down the track, has to wait for the length and the ball, which is slower and he can only push it to short mid-wicket.
Comes down the track a touch, the length is short, so Dhawan goes back and works it towards square leg.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Another short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for one more.
Around off, worked wide of long on for a run.
A tad short, around middle, Dhawan goes back and punches it down the ground to long on for a run.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Full on middle, pushed down the ground to long on for a single.
WIDE. Darted down the leg side, Karthik misses his flick.

DROPPED! But a tough chance. Flighted wide outside off, DK reaches out to play a cover drive but ends up slicing it. The ball goes uppishly towards backward point where Mosaddek Hossain leaps to his left, sticks out his right hand but the ball pops out. Good effort. A single taken.
A bit of flight on middle and leg, Shikhar jumps down the track and pushes it towards long on for one more.
Flighted outside off, driven towards long off for another single.
Landed outside off, worked behind square leg for one.
Tossed up beautifully outside off, Karthik leans and plays an equally beautiful cover drive but straight to sweeper cover. Just a run.
Landed around middle and leg, Dhawan goes back and works it through backward square leg for a single.
SUNZAMUL ISLAM to bowl his left-arm spinners now.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
50-run stand is up in 57 balls.
Goes back and works it through the leg side for a single.
Around off, Dinesh looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge back to the bowler.
Full and around middle and off, watchfully blocked out.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.

Time for Drinks Break. So a Bangladesh have kept things under control in the first 15 overs. India after losing two early wickets have steadied their ship with a good partnership building between Dinesh Karthik and Shikhar Dhawan.
Short outside off again, Karthik watches it go through to the keeper.
Persisting with the short stuff Taskin, Karthik evades the short one.
Bangs it short again, Dhawan comes inside the line and pulls it down to deep square leg for a run.
Short on the body of Dhawan, who pulls it wide of fine leg for a couple.
Length ball, Dhawan defends it off the back foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length ball, Karthik guides it down to third man for a run.
Tosses it up, Dhawan goes for the drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Cuts the short ball, through the off side for a run.
Dhawan comes down the track and drives it down to long off for a run.
Quicker ball on middle, Karthik pushes it to deep covers for a run.
Works the ball of middle on the leg side.
Tosses it up on off stump, Karthik gets forward and defends it.
Length ball on off, angling away. Dhawan defends it off the back foot.
Short on the body, Karthik plays it with soft hands on the leg side for a run.
Full on middle, Karthik drives it to covers.
Bangs it in short on the body of the batsman, Dhawan pulls it down to fine leg for a run.
Short on the leg stump, Karthik tucks it to fine leg for a run.
Back of a length outside off, Karthik opens the face of the bat and guides it uppishly down to third man for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Driven towards the mid-on region.
Big shout again! Full ball, Dhawan tries to sweep but misses and is struck on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire turns it down. This was closer than the last one.
Half appeal for LBW, bowls it full on leg stump, Dhawan goes for flick but misses it and is struck on the pads. They appeal but is given not out.
Drives the full ball back to the bowler.
Tosses it on a length, Dhawan defends it off the front foot.
Mehedi Hasan is brought into the attack.
Karthik comes down the track and tries to flick the full on leg stump but misses and it has not been signaled a wide.
Bangs the free hit short, Karthik goes for the pull, gets a top edge and lands between square leg and fine leg. They get through for two.
Free Hit coming up.
NO BALL! Taskin over steps. Bowls it on a length Karthik defends it off the front foot. India have a free hit.
Length ball, Dhawan opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a run.
Full ball on off, drives it straight to mid off
Banged in short, Dhawan goes for the pull but gets a top edge. It goes over the keeper and the man at fine leg makes a good stop and concedes only two.
Full ball on off side, Karthik drives it through the covers. The ball stops due to the slow outfield and they run three.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Batsman charges down the track, Soumya bowls it slightly short on the leg stump. Dhawan tucks it on the leg side for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Driven beautiful down the ground. Full on off stump and Dhawan drives it to the long off boundary.

FOUR! LOVELY TIMING! Length on off, Dhawan pushes it through the covers. Hasan dives at the boundary and pushes the ball back. They check for the boundary and there is contact with the fence when he tries to push back the ball, The umpire signals a boundary.
Starts of with a length ball, Dhawan defends it off the front foot.
Soumya Sarkar comes into the attack.
FOUR! What a shot. Rahman bowls it full on off stump, Karthik drives it beautifully down the ground for a boundary.
BRILLIANT FROM SABBIR! Dhawan punches the length ball thorugh cover point. Sabbir dives to his left and saves runs for his team.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Dhawan defends the length ball off the front foot.
Length ball, Dhawan defends it off the front foot.
Almost another wicket for Rahman. Full outside off invites the batsman to drive, Karthik gets a thick edge through the vacant second slip area for a run.
Length ball, Dhawan defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length ball, Kartik punches it firmly off the back foot through cover point. Sabbir makes a good diving stop to his left and saved a certain boundary but they get through for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full this time and Kartik drives it through covers for a couple.
FOUR! Lovely shot that should get him going. Bangs it on a length, Kartik rocks onto the back foot and pushes it through cover-point for a boundary.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Umpire signals a wide.
Kartik was lucky there, Taskin hits a length gets extra bounce, Kartik goes to leave it but gets hit on the elbow and almost another drag onto the stumps.
Taskin Ahmed comes onto bowl.
Around middle and leg, Shikhar works it behind square leg and comes back for the second.
Full and outside off, Dhawan shoulders arms.
Full and outside off, DK pushes hard and gets a thick outside edge to third man. A single to get off the mark.
Outside off, this time it is left alone.
Almost gone first ball. Full and just outside off, angling away, Dinesh pushes inside the line and is beaten.

DINESH KARTHIK walks in at number 4, replacing Rahane. He is taking a long time to take guard here. Looking at the skies, praying, then marking his guard, backing away and finally, he is ready. Mustafizur is waiting, waiting and waiting and starts to smile. This is the new Dinesh Karthik.

OUT! Another one chops it down! A fuller length ball outside off, Rahane looks to play the cover drive but there is no feet movement. As a result, he gets a thick inside edge which crashes into the stumps. Mustafizur is all smiles, but there nothing special in that delivery. Just poor feet movement. Or none rather.
Back of a length ball, Dhawan defends it off the back foot.
Ahead of a length, Dhawan drives it to mid off.
Tamim Iqbal and Mashrafe Mortaza are not playing today for Bangladesh. Clearly the side fielding currently is looking to try out its reserves.
FOUR! Tad short on the body of Dhawan, who rocks back and pulls it uppishly through the vacant mid-wicket area for a boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full ball on off stump, Dhawan drives it straight to short covers.
Rubel bangs it on a length, Dhawan pushes it on the off side off the back foot.
Full on middle, Rahane drives it back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Lovely stuff from the bowler. Back of a length ball angles away from the batsman. Rahane pokes at it and gets beaten.
Length ball, the batsman pushes it to covers.
Bowls it wide outside off on a length, Rahane lets it go through to the keeper.
FOUR! That made a lovely sound of the bat. Full ball on middle, Rahane leans into it and drives it straight back past the bowler for a boundary. Lovely shot by Rahane.
Lands it on a length outside off, Rahane defends it off the front foot.
Guides the length ball bowled outside off down to third man for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, Dhawan defends it onto the ground on the off side and they run through for a single. Good running there.
Rubel bowls it outside off stump, Rahane guides it down to third man for a run.
Rahane defends the length ball on off stump off the back foot.
Lands it on a length, Rahane defends it off the back foot.
Full outside off, Rahane drives it straight to covers.
Slower ball on the pads, Rahane flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Length ball on off stump, Rahane pushes it to covers.
Full on leg stump, Dhawan drives it to mid on for a single.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Bowls it on the pads, Rahane flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Wide outside off, Rahane lets the ball go through to the keeper.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Rahane goes for the flick but misses and is signaled wide.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Drifts on the pads, Rahane flicks it to square leg.

Big appeal for LBW but is given not out by the umpire. Rubel bowls it on a length on middle, the ball nips back in a little and hits Rahane on the pads who goes to flick but misses it. They all go up but the umpire gives it not out. Might be missing leg.
Short ball bowled on the body of the batsman, Rahane comes inside the line and pulls it down to fine leg for a couple.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rahane guides it to the point region.
Ajinkya Rahane comes in at no.3
OUT! What a start for Bangladesh. Rubel bowls it short outside off, Rohit tries to push it off the back foot but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. Not the return Rohit wanted.
Rubel Hossain will bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Sloppy from Bangladesh, on the shorter side outside off stump. Dhawan cuts it to point where Mosaddek misfields the ball at point and concedes two.
Dhawan defends it the length ball on off stump off the back foot.
Lands it on a length on middle, Dhawan tucks it to square leg.
BEATEN! Length ball on off, moves away of the deck. Dhawan pokes at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Back of a length ball on off stump, Rohit plays it down with soft hands off the back foot on the offside and they complete a single.
Length ball, angling away, the batsman lets the ball go through to the keeper.
The umpires are walking out to the middle. Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan will open the batting for India. Mustafizur Rahman will start the bowling for Bangladesh. Two slips in place for him.

Virat Kohli says they also wanted to bat first, he adds the wicket looks good, but gets difficult to score when the conditions get overcast and is easy to play your shots when it is sunny. Rohit will be playing today, Yuvraj is back in the nets but not sure about him batting today.

Bangladesh skipper, Shakib Al Hasan says that he will bowl first. Reckons that they have been batting well so they are looking forward to chase this time. Mentions that the wicket looks like a used one so it will be a slow one. Expects a high-scoring game. Informs that they have are resting a couple of players today as their main game is just two days away.

Pitch Report - Sourav Ganguly doing the pitch report says that he expects good carry on this wicket. Adds that this deck looks a really good one for the batsmen. Also expects some rough outside off to work for the left-arm spinners. Hopes that the wicket provides some good pace and carry throughout.
TOSS - BANGLADESH WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD!

Bangladesh would want to get back to winning ways, after losing a hard fought battle against Pakistan in their first warm-up game. Beating the defending champions today would boost their confidence heading into the Champions Trophy.

Hello and a warm welcome to the warm-up game for the Champions Trophy, 2017 between India and Bangladesh at The Oval. The reigning champions are looking a well-balanced side after their convincing victory over New Zealand in their last practice game.  They would want to make it two wins out of two and continue their winning momentum heading into the Champions Trophy.
